reading: The success flag is EPA-positive and is not a make result, so no rate is built on it. In this window it happens to agree with the publisher on every good and failed extra point and on every two-point try. It does not agree on blocked extra points, which it records as misses, and on rows with no result. A success-based rate would therefore differ from the publisher rate by the blocked rows. The engine reads only the publisher fields (measure_kick_outcomes.load_try_results), and the tool prints no success-based rate (test_kick_results.test_the_tool_contains_no_rate_built_on_the_success_flag).
